newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Speaker refers Peters fracas to privileges cmtte.
newsitem.headline: Speaker refers Peters fracas to privileges cmtte.

text.p: New Zealand Speaker Doug Kidd on Wednesday referred a fracas between Treasurer Winston Peters and National Party backbench MP John Banks to parliament's privileges committee.

"I think that a question of privilege is involved and the privileges committee should consider the allegation that on Wednesday, 5 March, the Honourable Winston Peters assaulted the Honourable John Banks on account of Mr Banks' conduct in Parliament and thereby a contempt of the House," Kidd said.
The privileges committee will determine the facts and any culpability over the incident.
The ruling arose after a complaint by Alliance Leader Jim Anderton who said he witnessed the events.
Kidd ruled there was no question of privilege in a related incident where New Zealand First deputy leader Tau Henare attempted to stop a journalist recording the Peters-Banks fracas.
